_about: AI data-use terms per (vendor, feature), labelled 2026-10-21 by reading each fetched page. Scored: retention_days, used_for_training, zdr. Secondary (reported, not in the headline): retention_condition, region, third_party_access. Every non-empty evidence sentence is verbatim in the source (tests/test_a1_datause.py). split=heldout items were never used while writing or revising the prompt or the baseline. Label rules are in owin/datause/schema.py (LABEL_RULES). Label changes after a model run are recorded per item in label_history and in RELABELS (owin/datause/evaluate.py); the pre-change score is kept in eval/datause/v2-before-relabel-score.json.
